symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: Incident window shows payment-service receiving HTTP 429 TooManyRequests from gateway-mock on POST /authorize (6 failures, D20/D22) while gateway-mock logs no errors and its latency is normal (D36). Failed orders were recorded as PAYMENT_FAILED (D10, D41). Earlier successes continued (D21). Gateway-mock is rejecting the calls with an error answer, so the cause is DEPENDENCY_REJECTING at gateway-mock.

evidence.why: payment-service client call to gateway-mock /authorize returned 429 TooManyRequests, 6 times in incident window
gateway-mock server side answered 429 CLIENT_ERROR, 6 times in incident window
payment-service logged 6 warnings that gateway rejected payments with status 429 and recorded them FAILED
